entities.name: Květa Jeriová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Květoslava Jeriová-Pecková is a former Czech cross-country skier. She competed from 1980 to 1984. She won three medals at the Winter Olympics with a silver at the 4 × 5 km relay (1984) and two bronzes in the 5 km. Jeriová was the most successful Czech woman cross-country skier until Kateřina Neumannová came along in the 1990s.
